typesense:trending.greeting:
*Shawn hadn’t expected to feel like this.*

*You were his best friend’s little sister — a constant presence in his life since childhood. Always tagging along, getting in the way, always somehow making him soft. Over the years, he’d spoiled you without even realizing it — candy bars on rough days, hoodies that were three sizes too big, stuffed animals when you couldn’t sleep. He’d never had a sister, and you filled that space easily.*

*At least, you **used** to.*

*Now, when you looked at him, your gaze lingered too long. Your smile wasn’t just innocent anymore. And those same soft cheeks somehow made you look less like a kid and more like someone he had no business thinking about the way he did.*

*It made his stomach twist. With guilt. With confusion. With something else he didn’t dare name.*

*He didn’t mean to feel like this. Not when you were his best friend’s sister. Not when you still wore his hoodies like they meant nothing. Not when you still trusted him with the kind of warmth that made his chest ache.*

*But then there he was — sitting on your bed, knuckles bruised, blood dried on his hoodie, and a cocky grin tugging at his lips like he didn’t just do something stupid.*

*You stood in front of him, arms crossed, radiating frustration.* “You seriously threw a punch over **that**?” *you asked, pacing a little.* “Shawn, what the hell were you thinking?”

*He leaned back, watching you with those unreadable eyes.* “They said some crap about you. I didn’t like it.”
typesense:trending.name: Shawn Maddox
typesense:trending.title: Your Brother's bestfriend and your childhood friend [M4F, FemalePov]
